task: Find a half-remembered report by title words
query_wording: I remember ‘learning poverty’ was in the title. Can you find the report?

turns.user: I remember ‘learning poverty’ was in the title. Can you find the report?

expected_sources.note: Unquoted display_title=learning poverty matches either word (15,413 records on 2026-11-22); the quoted phrase gives 505, mostly country Learning Poverty Briefs.

expected_sources.title: Ending Learning Poverty : What Will It Take?
expected_sources.role: Flagship report that introduced the measure

expected_sources.title: Realizing the Future of Learning : From Learning Poverty to Learning for Everyone, Everywhere

expected_sources.role: Candidate (latest edition; earlier editions 161348 of 2021 and 191787 of 2024-06)

text: About 505 Documents & Reports records have "learning poverty" in the title, most of them one-country Learning Poverty Briefs (e.g. Jordan, Mexico, Belize 2024). The likeliest reports are:

- Ending Learning Poverty: What Will It Take? (World, Working Paper 142659, 2019-10-01): the report that introduced the learning poverty measure. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/395151571251399043
- Realizing the Future of Learning: From Learning Poverty to Learning for Everyone, Everywhere (World, Report 154703, 2020-12-01). http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/250981606928190510
- Learning Poverty Updates and Revisions: What's New? (World; editions 2021-07 as Working Paper 161348, 2024-06-25 as Report 191787, 2024-11-19 as Report 193947).
- Scaling Up Interventions to Reduce Learning Poverty in South Asia: The Six Scaling Principles for Success (South Asia, Report 203942, 2025-03-31).
- Learning Poverty in Ethiopia: Status, Key Factors, and Priority Reduction Strategies (Ethiopia, 2022-05-31).
- Advancing Arabic Language Teaching and Learning: A Path to Reducing Learning Poverty in the Middle East and North Africa (2021, English and Arabic).
If one of these isn't it, the country, year or region would narrow the list (for example to a specific country's Learning Poverty Brief).

right_sources: Searches titles for the phrase (not a plain keyword search over all fields) and returns several candidates, including Ending Learning Poverty: What Will It Take? (142659).
grounded: Candidate titles, countries/regions and dates match the records; links come from the records.
complete: Gives several candidates with title, country or region and date, so the user can pick, rather than asserting a single answer.
scoped: Says there are many matches (hundreds, mostly country briefs) and offers a way to narrow them.

notes: New country briefs may add to the count.
